limitations: The import packages existing evidence; it introduces no new scientific result.
Diagnostics are bounded to the imported tasks, models, seeds, and recorded protocol.
Trajectory decay is diagnostic evidence, not proof of universal turnpike behavior or operational stability.
Aggregate hard-test results do not establish universal prompt superiority.
Segmented soft evaluation is unusable when no row has a positive sample count.
Trajectory decay is a diagnostic signal, not proof of operational model stability.
Sibling NPZ files are referenced and hashed only; they are not loaded or copied.
A failed validation verdict is retained as negative evidence and does not support the diagnostic.
No Riccati/DARE diagnostic source was discovered in this PEOC bundle.
No soft-to-hard projection diagnostic source was discovered in this PEOC bundle.

safe_claim: This bounded case study reports the imported PEOC measurements and their recorded limitations; it is not a universal benchmark. The hard-test summary contains task-, model-, and method-specific results. For the selected paired summaries, stationary arithmetic traces report a stronger fitted decay signature than heterogeneous GSM8K traces. The stage-heterogeneity validation reported FAIL. The segmented soft summary is unusable for a positive claim.
safe_claim_zh: 本案例只报告导入的 PEOC 测量结果及其限制, 不代表通用基准结论。Hard-test 汇总提供了任务、模型和方法层面的具体结果。在选中的配对汇总中, 平稳算术轨迹的拟合衰减信号强于异质 GSM8K 轨迹。阶段异质性验证的记录结果为 FAIL。分段 soft 汇总不能用于支持正向结论。
